subject: POC environment setup playbook + MAP close timeline
messages:

Subject: POC timeline & env details request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to validate Redwood for our clinical search/summarization workflows. To move forward we need a short MAP and an environment playbook we can run against our infra team. Specifically we need:

- A proposed close timeline (POC start, run window, success criteria, signoff)
- A simple checklist for org setup and API key provisioning we can hand to our platform team
- Network requirements: IP allowlist ranges (CIDR), whether VPC peering is required for the evaluation, and any requirements for egress rules

Procurement will also need the proposed SOW and a rough cost estimate to approve a 4-week POC. Can you send a MAP that binds the technical and procurement steps so we can get internal approvals?

Appreciate a one-pager we can circulate.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product, Nova Diagnostics
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline & env details request

Hi Samira — great to hear. Attached is a first-draft MAP and a short network playbook (MAP_NovaDiag_v1.xlsx and redwood-poc-network-instructions.pdf). High-level proposal below and action owners so you can share with Procurement and Platform.

Proposed MAP (summary)
- Week 0 (Kickoff): Org & accounts created, API key issuance, IP allowlist provided by Nova (Owner: Nova DevOps)
- Week 1 (Provisioning): VPC peering request (if needed), sample request traffic to staging endpoints, baseline perf smoke tests (Owner: Redwood SE — Marissa)
- Week 2 (Run & iterate): Run representative test prompts, gather logs/metrics, adjust batching/kv-cache config (Owner: Nova + Redwood)
- Week 3 (Evaluation & close): Review quality metrics vs success criteria, decision review and SOW/next-step pricing (Owner: Samira + Procurement)

Success criteria (suggested — can be tuned)
- 95th p50 latency for 512-token sequences under target qps <= 350ms
- End-to-end quality: 85% pass rate on the supplied eval prompt set (attached in MAP)
- No critical security blockers in onboarding checklist

Network & security notes (short)
- API keys: scoped keys are preferred (read-only eval vs production write). See api-key-scope-examples.txt attached.
- IP allowlist: allowlist our regional egress subnets in the playbook. For US region, default CIDR block for testing: 34.200.12.0/24 and 34.200.13.0/24 (please confirm with your firewall team).
- VPC peering: optional for low-latency private path. If you want to enable peering, we need a contact for Nova's cloud network engineer and a window of 2–4 hours for setup and verification (Owner: Nova DevOps + Redwood Infra).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Review attachments and update the MAP with any internal dates — procurement can use the SOW link in related_links.
2) Quick 30-min handoff call with Marissa and your DevOps to run through the network checklist — propose Thu 11/12 at 10:00 AM PT.

I added Marissa and Grace from our side for the technical handoff and success criteria. Happy to tighten numbers once we have your expected qps and prompt lengths.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: DevOps Team <devops@novadiagnostics.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@novadiagnostics.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:31:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: POC timeline & env details request

Hi team — quick technical checklist and minimal commands your infra team asked for during the call. I included small examples in the attached PDF.

Minimum onboarding items for the POC (technical)
- Organization & users: create a single Redwood org for the eval; create two service-level API keys: staging-eval-key and telemetry-key (scoped, rotation set to 90 days)
- IP allowlist: add the two CIDR blocks Priyom suggested. If you cannot add CIDRs, we can open a short-lived tunnel during testing but peering is preferred.
- VPC peering: if you request it, we will provide peering configuration for AWS (we support Azure/GCP patterns too). Typical peering flow: exchange VPC IDs, accept peering, update route tables, update security groups to permit outbound 443 to Redwood endpoints.
- Logs & telemetry: enable request/response logging to the staging bucket you specify; set a retention of 30 days for POC artifacts.

Sample curl (use staging-eval-key):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <staging-eval-key>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-eval","input":"<sample prompt>","max_tokens":256}'

Attachments in this message: redwood-poc-network-instructions.pdf (detailed step list) and api-key-scope-examples.txt.

If you can confirm the cw-agent contact or the cloud engineer for peering (name + email), we’ll schedule the peering window.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

2) DevOps: we can allowlist the two CIDRs but would like clarification on API key scopes. Are there scopes that disable telemetry forwarding or usage billing during POC? We also need to confirm data residency — PII must remain in our account during evaluation.

Procurement looped in: procurement@novadiagnostics.com.

Appreciate a quick follow-up before Monday so we can lock in the kickoff.

Best,
Samira

Subject: Re: POC timeline & env details request — next steps and NTE

Samira — thanks for the quick review. Short answers and next steps below so Procurement can proceed.

Procurement: Not-to-exceed (NTE) for 4-week POC
- Platform access + equivalent of 40k tokens/day test throughput (staging): $6,000 flat for the 4-week window (covers host, telemetry retention to 30 days, and SE support).
- Optional VPC peering setup & validation (one-time): $1,200 (if requested)
- Total NTE (worst case): $7,200

API key & data residency notes
- API keys: we can issue scoped keys that disable telemetry export if you choose — we provide a telemetry-key toggle in the console; we can also configure a redaction policy for PII captured in logs.
- Data residency: for the POC we can ensure all collected artifacts (request/response logs) are written to the staging bucket you control; no customer PII will be stored in Redwood-managed long-term storage during the eval unless you explicitly opt in.

Scheduling:
- Kickoff + handoff call (30m) with Marissa: Mon 11/22 at 10:00 AM PT — please confirm attendee list.
- If you want peering, please assign a cloud engineer we can coordinate with and provide the VPC ID and preferred 2–4 hour window; we’ll slot a peering session during Week 0.

Next action items (short)
- Samira/DevOps: confirm the allowlisted CIDRs and the cloud contact for peering (reply to this thread).
- Procurement: mark the NTE and confirm purchase order/DocuSign next steps.
- Redwood: we will upload a finalized MAP (MAP_NovaDiag_v1.xlsx) to the shared Drive and a short SOW for signature. Link: https://docusign.com/rd-novadiag-sow

If that looks aligned I’ll lock the kickoff and send calendar invites.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
